title: Post-processing strategies for generative design outcomes in a UAV tail boom
authors: Michał Piotr Kowalik, Piotr Stapinski, Mateusz Papis
abstract: Generative design produces structurally efficient geometries whose complex, organic shapes require post-processing before they can be manufactured by fused filament fabrication (FFF). This paper compares two post-processing strategies applied to the same generative design outcome for the tail boom of an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). The first, complex variant follows the raw topology closely; the second, simplified variant uses symmetric arms, self-supporting geometry, and uniform cross-sections oriented toward FFF manufacturability. Both variants were evaluated by finite element analysis (FEA) comprising linear static and buckling studies under identical loading conditions, and scaled prototypes of the simplified variant were printed in two bounding infill configurations and load-tested. The simplification reduced mass by 4% and print time by 20% while eliminating support structures, at the cost of a 31% increase in peak stress, which remained below 2% of the ultimate tensile strength assumed in the FEA model. Stress concentrations predicted by FEA were qualitatively consistent with the fracture locations observed in testing. Within the studied case and under the analyzed quasi-static loads, the stress increase did not change the assessment of load-bearing adequacy, indicating that manufacturing-oriented simplification of generative design outcomes can improve printability while reducing print time and material use.
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

infographic.key_insight: Manufacturing-oriented simplification of a generatively designed UAV tail boom reduced mass by 4% and print time by 20%, eliminated supports, and retained load-bearing adequacy under the analyzed quasi-static loads.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Adapting organic generative designs to FFF constraints can improve manufacturability without compromising assessed structural adequacy in this case.
method: Compared topology-faithful and simplified variants of the same generative design.
Evaluated both using linear static and buckling FEA under identical loads.
Printed scaled simplified prototypes with two bounding infill configurations and load-tested them.
infographic.evidence_signal: Simplification increased peak FEA stress by 31%, but it remained below 2% of the assumed ultimate tensile strength; predicted stress concentrations qualitatively matched observed fracture locations.
infographic.watch_item: Results are case-specific: scaled prototype tests and quasi-static analyses do not establish full-scale performance under fatigue, dynamic loading, or FFF material variability.
infographic.paper_title: Post-processing strategies for generative design outcomes in a UAV tail boom

zh-Hans.title: 无人机尾梁生成式设计结果的后处理策略
zh-Hans.abstract: 生成式设计能够产生结构效率高的几何形状，但其复杂的有机形态需要经过后处理，才能采用熔融丝材制造（FFF）工艺制造。本文针对无人机（UAV）尾梁的同一生成式设计结果，比较了两种后处理策略。第一种为复杂方案，紧密遵循原始拓扑；第二种为简化方案，采用对称臂、自支撑几何形状和均匀截面，以适应FFF制造要求。在相同载荷条件下，通过包含线性静力分析和屈曲分析的有限元分析（FEA）对两种方案进行了评估，并采用两种界限填充配置打印简化方案的缩比原型，开展承载试验。简化使质量降低了4%，打印时间缩短了20%，同时无需支撑结构，代价是峰值应力增加了31%，但该应力仍低于FEA模型中假定的极限抗拉强度的2%。FEA预测的应力集中位置与试验中观察到的断裂位置在定性上相符。在所研究的案例及所分析的准静态载荷条件下，应力增加未改变对承载能力充足性的评估，表明面向制造的生成式设计结果简化能够改善可打印性，同时减少打印时间和材料用量。

infographic.key_insight: 对生成式设计的无人机尾梁进行面向制造的简化，使质量降低了4%，打印时间缩短了20%，无需支撑结构，并在所分析的准静态载荷下保持了充足的承载能力。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 使有机形态的生成式设计适应FFF约束，可以改善可制造性，且在本案例中不会损害经评估的结构承载能力充足性。
method: 比较了同一生成式设计中忠实于原始拓扑的方案与简化方案。
在相同载荷下，采用线性静力和屈曲FEA对两种方案进行了评估。
采用两种界限填充配置打印简化方案的缩比原型，并开展承载试验。
infographic.evidence_signal: 简化使FEA峰值应力增加了31%，但该应力仍低于假定极限抗拉强度的2%；预测的应力集中位置与观察到的断裂位置在定性上相符。
infographic.watch_item: 结果具有案例特异性：缩比原型试验和准静态分析并不能确定全尺寸结构在疲劳、动态载荷或FFF材料变异性影响下的性能。

title: Spatial characteristic of temperature distribution and material flow behaviors during bobbin tool friction stir welding: a computational fluid dynamics study
authors: Honghua Han, Xu Yan, Yanhua Zhao, Suhong Zhang, Qingyu Shi, Chengle Yang
abstract: The incorporation of dual shoulders endows bobbin tool friction stir welding (BT-FSW) with spatially distinct heat transfer and material flow characteristics relative to conventional FSW. The vague understanding of these processes hinders efficient optimization of BT-FSW. To address this gap, a computational fluid dynamics (CFD) model, which considered the fully coupling of thermo-mechanical-fluid, was established. Three contact pressure models, namely the Front-Peaked Contact Pressure Model (FP-CPM), Uniform Contact Pressure Model (U-CPM), and Rear-Peaked Contact Pressure Model (RP-CPM), were proposed to model the pressure distribution at the tool-workpiece (T/W) interface. The results show that the distribution of contact pressure at the T/W interface constitutes a critical factor governing the temperature field and flow behavior during welding stage. The FP-CPM provided superior predictive accuracy for the welding temperature, the shape of plastic deformation zone, and material flow trajectories, compared to U-CPM and RP-CPM. Agreed by both experiment and prediction, the temperature on the retreating side (RS) exceeded that on the advancing side (AS). Revealed by FP-CPM model, this phenomenon is attributable to the deflection of high-temperature material from the AS toward the RS, driven by the intense material flow ahead of the tool induced by the high-pressure zone. At the T/W interface, the material exhibited asymmetric horizontal flow with a thin layer ahead of the tool and a broader low-speed region behind the tool. Concurrently, vertical migration featured circumferential flow around the tool converging toward the plate mid-thickness.

infographic.key_insight: Front-peaked tool–workpiece contact pressure best explains BT-FSW temperature and material flow, including hotter retreating-side temperatures caused by hot material deflecting from the advancing side.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Accurate contact-pressure modeling can improve predictions used to optimize heat distribution and material transport in bobbin tool friction stir welding.
method: Developed a fully coupled thermo-mechanical-fluid CFD model.
Compared front-peaked, uniform, and rear-peaked interface contact-pressure models.
Examined temperature fields, plastic deformation zones, and material flow trajectories.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports superior predictive accuracy for the front-peaked model and experimental agreement that the retreating side was hotter than the advancing side, without quantitative error metrics.
infographic.watch_item: Applicability across other materials, tool geometries, and welding conditions is not established in the abstract.
infographic.paper_title: Spatial characteristic of temperature distribution and material flow behaviors during bobbin tool friction stir welding: a computational fluid dynamics study

zh-Hans.title: 双轴肩搅拌摩擦焊过程中温度分布与材料流动行为的空间特征：一项计算流体力学研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 与常规搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）相比，双轴肩结构使双轴肩搅拌摩擦焊（BT-FSW）具有不同的空间传热与材料流动特征。对这些过程认识不清，阻碍了BT-FSW的高效优化。为弥补这一不足，建立了考虑热–力–流体完全耦合的计算流体力学（CFD）模型。提出了三种接触压力模型，即前部峰值接触压力模型（Front-Peaked Contact Pressure Model，FP-CPM）、均匀接触压力模型（Uniform Contact Pressure Model，U-CPM）和后部峰值接触压力模型（Rear-Peaked Contact Pressure Model，RP-CPM），用于模拟搅拌头–工件（T/W）界面的压力分布。结果表明，T/W界面的接触压力分布是决定焊接阶段温度场与流动行为的关键因素。与U-CPM和RP-CPM相比，FP-CPM对焊接温度、塑性变形区形状及材料流动轨迹的预测更为准确。实验与预测均表明，后退侧（RS）的温度高于前进侧（AS）。FP-CPM模型揭示，这一现象源于高压区诱发的搅拌头前方强烈材料流动，该流动驱使高温材料从AS向RS偏转。在T/W界面处，材料呈现不对称的水平流动，搅拌头前方形成薄层，后方则形成较宽的低速区域。同时，竖向迁移表现为绕搅拌头的周向流动向板厚中部汇聚。

infographic.key_insight: 前部峰值型搅拌头–工件接触压力最能解释BT-FSW中的温度与材料流动，包括高温材料从前进侧偏转而导致后退侧温度更高的现象。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 准确的接触压力建模可提高预测精度，从而支持双轴肩搅拌摩擦焊中热量分布与材料输运的优化。
method: 建立了热–力–流体完全耦合的CFD模型。
比较了前部峰值型、均匀型和后部峰值型界面接触压力模型。
考察了温度场、塑性变形区及材料流动轨迹。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告称，前部峰值模型具有更高的预测精度，且后退侧温度高于前进侧这一结果与实验一致，但未提供定量误差指标。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要尚未确立该模型对其他材料、搅拌头几何形状及焊接条件的适用性。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: Combined computational and neural-network modelling identified an optimal tested HDPE friction stir welding condition of 1500 rpm, 30 mm/min and 60 °C bottom preheating.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The approach supports process-window selection for HDPE joints by predicting thermal response, axial forces and defect formation.
method: Develop a 3D Coupled Eulerian–Lagrangian model of temperature, forces, material flow and weld defects.
Train two multilayer perceptron networks on experimental temperature and axial-force histories.
Combine simulations and ANN predictions to map defective and defect-free welding windows.
infographic.evidence_signal: Experimental validation showed good agreement with CEL predictions; ANNs achieved R² of 0.91–0.99, while 60 °C preheating reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N to about 1100 N.
infographic.watch_item: Predictive performance beyond the tested welding parameters and HDPE conditions remains unestablished.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于预测高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊接质量的计算建模与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）已被认可为一种连接热塑性材料的有效技术。本研究综合采用计算方法和机器学习方法，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊接温度、垂直轴向力、材料流动和缺陷形成等特征进行预测，并通过实验结果加以验证。研究建立了三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，用于模拟不同转速、焊接速度和底部预热条件下的HDPE焊接过程。CEL数值模型通过实验数据得到验证，在孔洞形成以及热响应和力学响应的预测方面表现出很好的吻合度。结果表明，底面预热能够有效减小温度梯度，并抑制垂直力波动。定量而言，60 °C底面预热使峰值下压力从1600 N降至接近1100 N，并使峰值温度从未预热时的70 °C升至约100 °C，从而减缓厚度方向的温度梯度，使轴向力分布更加稳定。同时，利用实验数据训练了两个多层感知机人工神经网络（ANN），以预测温度和轴向力随时间变化的响应，其R2介于0.91和0.99之间，表明它们在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有较高的精度和较强的泛化能力。CEL计算模拟准确预测了焊接区域的形貌，包括搅拌区、热机械影响区和热影响区；而CEL–ANN联合框架能够快速生成工艺图，标示有缺陷和无缺陷的焊接工艺窗口。在所测试条件下，最优条件为1500 rpm、30 mm/min和60 °C预热；在1000 rpm且未预热时，由于形成虫孔缺陷，观察到较差的可焊性。这些发现为制备可靠的HDPE接头提供了以工艺为导向的设计指南，并展示了计算建模与机器学习相结合如何实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW工艺的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，同时支持其在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

infographic.key_insight: 计算建模与神经网络建模相结合，确定了所测试条件下HDPE搅拌摩擦焊的最优工艺条件：1500 rpm、30 mm/min和60 °C底部预热。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该方法通过预测热响应、轴向力和缺陷形成，为HDPE接头的工艺窗口选择提供支持。
method: 建立用于预测温度、力、材料流动和焊接缺陷的三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日模型。
利用实验测得的温度和轴向力时间历程训练两个多层感知机网络。
结合模拟结果与ANN预测，绘制有缺陷和无缺陷的焊接工艺窗口图。
infographic.evidence_signal: 实验验证表明，实验结果与CEL预测吻合良好；ANN的R²达到0.91–0.99，而60 °C预热使峰值下压力从1600 N降至约1100 N。
infographic.watch_item: 对于超出所测试焊接参数和HDPE条件范围的情况，其预测性能尚未得到证实。

title: Microstructure and surface performance of detonation gun sprayed 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY coatings on Al 6061-T6 substrate for structural applications
authors: T. Sampath kumar, Rajaram Ganesan, M.M. Reddy
abstract: Two protective coatings, 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY, were deposited on Al 6061-T6 alloy substrates using the Detonation Gun (D-Gun) thermal spray process. The deposited coatings were studied for their microstructure, phase composition, surface roughness, hardness, corrosion behaviour, wettability, and solid particle erosion resistance. Characterisation was done using SEM-EDS, XRD, AFM, nanoindentation, potentiodynamic polarisation, contact angle measurement, and erosion testing. SEM-EDS results showed that both coatings bonded well to the substrate with uniform thickness. The NiCrAlY coating had a denser microstructure with lower porosity compared to 80Ni20Cr. XRD identified CrNi phases with FCC crystal structure in 80Ni20Cr and Al₂NiY phases with orthorhombic structure in NiCrAlY. Nanocrystalline grain structure was observed in both coatings. AFM measurements showed that NiCrAlY had the lowest surface roughness among all three samples. Nanoindentation results showed that NiCrAlY hardness is approximately 10 times higher than 80Ni20Cr. Specifically, NiCrAlY showed a hardness of 7895.36 MPa (731.2 HV), compared with 780.11 MPa (72.25 HV) for 80Ni20Cr and 708.68 MPa for the uncoated Al 6061 substrate. Potentiodynamic polarisation tests in 3.5 wt% NaCl solution confirmed that NiCrAlY recorded the lowest corrosion current density of 6.625 × 10 -7 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.00567 mmpy. The 80Ni20Cr coating gave a corrosion current density of 1.585 × 10 - 6 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.01427 mmpy. Both figures are considerably lower than the bare substrate at 0.5185 mmpy. Contact angle measurements confirmed superhydrophobic behaviour for NiCrAlY and near-superhydrophobic behaviour for 80Ni20Cr. Solid particle erosion test results showed that 80Ni20Cr recorded the lowest mass loss. Under the laboratory conditions used (3.5 wt% NaCl at room temperature; a single erosion condition of 90° impact angle, 40 m/s and 5 min), NiCrAlY showed the better hardness and corrosion resistance, whereas 80Ni20Cr showed the better erosion resistance. These results indicate relative performance under the test conditions and are not a prediction of long-term service life.

infographic.key_insight: D-Gun-sprayed NiCrAlY delivered greater hardness and corrosion resistance on Al 6061-T6, while 80Ni20Cr had the lowest erosion mass loss under the tested conditions.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Coating selection should match the dominant damage mechanism: NiCrAlY for hardness and chloride corrosion resistance, or 80Ni20Cr for the tested particle-erosion exposure.
method: Deposit 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY coatings on Al 6061-T6 using detonation-gun thermal spraying.
Characterise microstructure, phases, roughness and hardness using SEM-EDS, XRD, AFM and nanoindentation.
Evaluate corrosion in 3.5 wt% NaCl, wettability by contact angle and solid-particle erosion.
infographic.evidence_signal: NiCrAlY reached 7895.36 MPa hardness versus 780.11 MPa for 80Ni20Cr, with corrosion rates of 0.00567 and 0.01427 mm/year, respectively, versus 0.5185 mm/year for bare aluminium.
infographic.watch_item: Room-temperature corrosion tests and one erosion condition (90° impact, 40 m/s, 5 min) establish relative laboratory performance, not long-term service life.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure and surface performance of detonation gun sprayed 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY coatings on Al 6061-T6 substrate for structural applications

zh-Hans.title: 面向结构应用的 Al 6061-T6 基体上爆炸喷涂 80Ni20Cr 和 NiCrAlY 涂层的微观组织与表面性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用爆炸喷涂（D-Gun）热喷涂工艺，在 Al 6061-T6 合金基体上沉积了 80Ni20Cr 和 NiCrAlY 两种防护涂层。研究了所沉积涂层的微观组织、物相组成、表面粗糙度、硬度、腐蚀行为、润湿性及抗固体颗粒冲蚀性能。采用 SEM-EDS、XRD、AFM、纳米压痕、动电位极化、接触角测量及冲蚀试验进行表征。SEM-EDS 结果表明，两种涂层均与基体结合良好，且厚度均匀。与 80Ni20Cr 相比，NiCrAlY 涂层的微观组织更致密，孔隙率更低。XRD 在 80Ni20Cr 中识别出具有面心立方（FCC）晶体结构的 CrNi 相，在 NiCrAlY 中识别出具有正交晶体结构的 Al₂NiY 相。两种涂层中均观察到纳米晶粒结构。AFM 测量表明，NiCrAlY 在全部三个样品中具有最低的表面粗糙度。纳米压痕结果表明，NiCrAlY 的硬度约为 80Ni20Cr 的 10 倍。具体而言，NiCrAlY 的硬度为 7895.36 MPa（731.2 HV），80Ni20Cr 的硬度为 780.11 MPa（72.25 HV），未涂覆的 Al 6061 基体硬度为 708.68 MPa。在 3.5 wt% NaCl 溶液中进行的动电位极化试验证实，NiCrAlY 的腐蚀电流密度最低，为 6.625 × 10⁻⁷ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为 0.00567 mmpy。80Ni20Cr 涂层的腐蚀电流密度为 1.585 × 10⁻⁶ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为 0.01427 mmpy。两种涂层的腐蚀速率均显著低于裸基体的 0.5185 mmpy。接触角测量证实，NiCrAlY 表现出超疏水行为，而 80Ni20Cr 表现出接近超疏水的行为。固体颗粒冲蚀试验结果表明，80Ni20Cr 的质量损失最低。在所采用的实验室条件下（室温下的 3.5 wt% NaCl 溶液；冲击角度为 90°、速度为 40 m/s、持续时间为 5 min 的单一冲蚀工况），NiCrAlY 表现出更高的硬度和更好的耐腐蚀性，而 80Ni20Cr 表现出更好的抗冲蚀性能。这些结果反映了试验条件下的相对性能，并非对长期服役寿命的预测。

infographic.key_insight: 在所测试条件下，Al 6061-T6 上的 D-Gun 喷涂 NiCrAlY 涂层具有更高的硬度和更好的耐腐蚀性，而 80Ni20Cr 的冲蚀质量损失最低。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 涂层选择应与主导损伤机制相匹配：若侧重硬度和耐氯化物腐蚀性，可选用 NiCrAlY；若针对本研究测试的颗粒冲蚀工况，则可选用 80Ni20Cr。
method: 采用爆炸喷涂热喷涂工艺，在 Al 6061-T6 上沉积 80Ni20Cr 和 NiCrAlY 涂层。
采用 SEM-EDS、XRD、AFM 和纳米压痕表征微观组织、物相、粗糙度及硬度。
在 3.5 wt% NaCl 溶液中评估腐蚀性能，通过接触角测量评估润湿性，并评估固体颗粒冲蚀性能。
infographic.evidence_signal: NiCrAlY 的硬度达到 7895.36 MPa，而 80Ni20Cr 为 780.11 MPa；两者的腐蚀速率分别为 0.00567 和 0.01427 mm/年，而裸铝为 0.5185 mm/年。
infographic.watch_item: 室温腐蚀试验和单一冲蚀工况（90° 冲击角度、40 m/s、5 min）确定的是实验室条件下的相对性能，而非长期服役寿命。

title: Thermodynamic modeling of chromium nitride precipitation in duplex stainless steels and weld metals
authors: Sten Wessman, Elin M. Westin, Staffan Hertzman
abstract: Duplex stainless steels (DSSs), containing roughly equal amounts of ferrite and austenite, offer an attractive combination of high strength and good corrosion resistance. The kinetics and factors controlling how fully ferritic material at temperatures near the solidus regains the desired 50/50 duplex microstructure around 1100 °C have previously been explored. The most important factor is nitrogen, present in the alloy, weld filler, and shielding gas. Other important factors are ferrite grain size and cooling rate, both influencing the time available for austenite formation at temperatures > 1000 °C, where kinetics remain favorable. Undesired intermetallic phases may form if the cooling rate is too slow, whereas rapid cooling rates and large ferrite grains promote chromium nitride precipitation. This study uses computational thermodynamics and the diffusion module DICTRA within Thermo-Calc to investigate how austenite formation influences nitride precipitation. The work focuses on the lean duplex grade LDX 2101, super duplex 2507, and 2509 weld metal filler. The simulations explore the influence of nitrogen content, grain size, and cooling rate on nitride precipitation. Furthermore, the commonly applied linear cooling rate in simulations is compared with non-linear conditions to evaluate their influence on nitride precipitation. Finally, the methodology developed in this work was applied to experimental data from a published study. Good agreement was obtained using the critical austenite spacing required for nitride precipitation as the comparison criterion. The simulations also reproduced the formation of nitride-free zones adjacent to austenite, indicating that high peak temperatures are required for these to form.

infographic.key_insight: Thermodynamic and diffusion simulations link austenite formation during cooling to chromium nitride precipitation in duplex stainless steels and weld metal.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Controlling nitrogen content, ferrite grain size, and cooling history can help balance austenite recovery against unwanted nitride and intermetallic formation during welding.
method: Used computational thermodynamics and Thermo-Calc DICTRA diffusion modeling.
Studied nitrogen content, grain size, and cooling rate in LDX 2101, 2507, and 2509 weld filler.
Compared linear and non-linear cooling histories.
infographic.evidence_signal: Simulations agreed well with published experiments using critical austenite spacing for nitride precipitation and reproduced nitride-free zones adjacent to austenite.
infographic.watch_item: Cooling-history assumptions require care, and the abstract reports no quantitative error metrics for the experimental comparison.
infographic.paper_title: Thermodynamic modeling of chromium nitride precipitation in duplex stainless steels and weld metals

zh-Hans.title: 双相不锈钢及焊缝金属中氮化铬析出的热力学建模
zh-Hans.abstract: 双相不锈钢（DSSs）含有比例大致相等的铁素体和奥氏体，兼具高强度和良好的耐腐蚀性。此前已有研究探讨了在接近固相线温度时呈全铁素体组织的材料如何在约1100 °C恢复所需的50/50双相显微组织，以及这一过程的动力学和控制因素。最重要的因素是合金、焊接填充材料和保护气体中的氮。其他重要因素包括铁素体晶粒尺寸和冷却速率，两者均影响在温度 > 1000 °C、动力学条件仍然有利时可供奥氏体形成的时间。冷却速率过慢可能形成不希望出现的金属间相，而快速冷却和较大的铁素体晶粒则会促进氮化铬析出。本研究采用计算热力学及Thermo-Calc中的扩散模块DICTRA，研究奥氏体形成如何影响氮化物析出。研究重点为贫合金双相不锈钢牌号LDX 2101、超级双相不锈钢2507以及2509焊接填充金属。模拟探讨了氮含量、晶粒尺寸和冷却速率对氮化物析出的影响。此外，将模拟中常用的线性冷却速率与非线性冷却条件进行比较，以评估它们对氮化物析出的影响。最后，将本研究开发的方法应用于一项已发表研究的实验数据。以氮化物析出所需的临界奥氏体间距作为比较判据，获得了良好的一致性。模拟还再现了奥氏体邻近区域无氮化物区的形成，表明这些区域的形成需要较高的峰值温度。

infographic.key_insight: 热力学和扩散模拟将双相不锈钢及焊缝金属冷却过程中的奥氏体形成与氮化铬析出联系起来。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 控制氮含量、铁素体晶粒尺寸和冷却历程，有助于在焊接过程中平衡奥氏体恢复与不希望出现的氮化物及金属间相的形成。
method: 采用计算热力学和Thermo-Calc DICTRA扩散建模。
研究了LDX 2101、2507和2509焊接填充材料中的氮含量、晶粒尺寸和冷却速率。
比较了线性和非线性冷却历程。
infographic.evidence_signal: 以氮化物析出的临界奥氏体间距为判据，模拟结果与已发表的实验结果吻合良好，并再现了奥氏体邻近区域的无氮化物区。
infographic.watch_item: 需要谨慎处理冷却历程假设，且摘要未报告与实验比较的定量误差指标。

title: Students’ Response Given by Welding Engineering Study Program at Politeknik Perkapalan Negeri Surabaya to the Study of Part of Speech in English Learning
authors: Rikat Eka Prastyawan, Daisy Dwijati Kumala Ratna Antariksih
abstract: Part of Speech becomes the basic learning of English which must be understood by the students in Learning. This study focused on the students’ response after getting the teaching about the basic patterns of English. The Data of this research was the information given by the students of Welding Engineering in Politeknik Perkapalan Negeri Surabaya. There were 28 students filling the questionnaires after getting the teaching of English Lecture. The data was analysed quantitively by using the diagram to know the students’ responses. The result showed that 78,6 % answered they knew well on the basic patterns and 21,4 % answered the did not understand them well. However, the students stated that 92,9 % learning about the basic patterns helped them speak English better. Even they gave comments that Speaking and Structure were related each other. It could be concluded that learning part of speech help the students understand the sentence accurately so they speak more fluently and accurately.
venue: International Journal of Scientific Research Studies

infographic.key_insight: Welding engineering students largely reported that learning English parts of speech and basic sentence patterns supported their speaking.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The findings concern English instruction for welding engineering students, not welding processes or material performance.
method: Taught English parts of speech and basic sentence patterns.
Collected post-instruction questionnaires from 28 welding engineering students at Politeknik Perkapalan Negeri Surabaya.
Summarized student responses quantitatively using diagrams.
infographic.evidence_signal: Of 28 respondents, 78.6% reported understanding the basic patterns well, while 92.9% said learning them helped their English speaking.
infographic.watch_item: A small, single-program sample and self-reported outcomes do not establish objective speaking improvement or causality.
infographic.paper_title: Students’ Response Given by Welding Engineering Study Program at Politeknik Perkapalan Negeri Surabaya to the Study of Part of Speech in English Learning

zh-Hans.title: Politeknik Perkapalan Negeri Surabaya 焊接工程专业学生对英语学习中词类教学的反应
zh-Hans.abstract: 词类是英语学习的基础内容，学生在学习过程中必须理解。本研究重点考察学生在接受英语基本句型教学后的反应。研究数据来自 Politeknik Perkapalan Negeri Surabaya 焊接工程专业学生提供的信息。28名学生在接受英语课程教学后填写了问卷。研究采用图表对数据进行定量分析，以了解学生的反应。结果显示，78,6 %的学生回答称自己对基本句型理解良好，21,4 %的学生回答称自己理解得不够好。不过，92,9 %的学生表示，学习基本句型有助于他们更好地说英语。他们还评论说，口语与语法结构相互关联。由此可得出结论，学习词类有助于学生准确理解句子，从而使他们的口语表达更加流利、准确。

infographic.key_insight: 焊接工程专业学生大多表示，学习英语词类和基本句型有助于他们的口语表达。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 研究结果涉及面向焊接工程专业学生的英语教学，而非焊接工艺或材料性能。
method: 教授英语词类和基本句型。
向 Politeknik Perkapalan Negeri Surabaya 的28名焊接工程专业学生收集教学后的问卷。
使用图表对学生的反应进行定量汇总。
infographic.evidence_signal: 在28名受访者中，78.6%表示自己对基本句型理解良好，92.9%表示学习这些句型有助于他们的英语口语表达。
infographic.watch_item: 样本规模较小且仅来自单一专业，加之结果基于自我报告，因此无法证实口语能力的客观提升或因果关系。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.key_insight: HVAF-sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr combined the lowest measured wear rate with the best corrosion resistance, while HVOF achieved the highest hardness.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The results support considering HVAF coatings for 304 stainless steel components exposed to both sliding wear and corrosion.
method: Deposit WC-10Co-4Cr on 304 stainless steel using APS, detonation spraying, HVOF and HVAF.
Compare microstructure, Vickers hardness, friction and volume wear rates.
Evaluate corrosion potential, current density and corrosion resistance.
infographic.evidence_signal: HVAF reduced volume wear rate from (36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ for uncoated steel to (1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m) and achieved the lowest corrosion current density, (1.75±0.02) µA/cm².
infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not specify wear-test conditions or corrosion medium, limiting direct transfer of the rankings to service environments.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、超音速氧燃料喷涂和超音速空气燃料喷涂WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层的显微组织、耐磨性与耐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性和耐蚀性。采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、超音速氧燃料喷涂（HVOFS）和超音速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，分别在304不锈钢基体上制备了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层，并系统研究和比较了这些涂层的显微组织、摩擦学性能和耐蚀性。结果表明，APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF制备的硬质合金涂层的维氏硬度分别为771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV和1162.2 HV，均高于304不锈钢。304不锈钢的体积磨损率约为(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)。APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层的体积磨损率分别约为(7.93±0.30)×10⁻⁵、(1.51±0.20)×10⁻⁵、(1.17±0.10)×10⁻⁵和(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，均低于304不锈钢。此外，304不锈钢基体、APS涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和HVAF涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为(0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01)和(0.43±0.01)。在WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的磨痕中可观察到剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是这些硬质合金涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主体，因此这三种涂层的耐磨性均优于APS涂层，其中HVOF和HVAF涂层的耐磨性能更佳。耐蚀性由高到低依次为HVAF涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和APS涂层。在本研究中，HVAF涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位（-0.37±0.01 V，相对于饱和甘汞电极SCE）、最低的腐蚀电流密度（1.75±0.02 μA/cm²）和最大的腐蚀电阻（20438.5 Ω）。APS涂层在这四种涂层中的耐蚀性最差。

infographic.key_insight: HVAF喷涂WC-10Co-4Cr涂层兼具最低的实测磨损率和最佳的耐蚀性，而HVOF涂层的硬度最高。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 研究结果支持考虑将HVAF涂层用于同时承受滑动磨损和腐蚀的304不锈钢部件。
method: 采用APS、爆炸喷涂、HVOF和HVAF在304不锈钢上沉积WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。
比较显微组织、维氏硬度、摩擦系数和体积磨损率。
评估腐蚀电位、电流密度和耐蚀性。
infographic.evidence_signal: HVAF将体积磨损率从未涂覆不锈钢的(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)降至(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，并获得最低的腐蚀电流密度，即(1.75±0.02) μA/cm²。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未说明磨损试验条件或腐蚀介质，因此不能将这些性能排序直接推广至服役环境。

title: Microstructure and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of HVOF and plasma sprayed Ni–Cr-based ceramic coatings on SA516 boiler steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71 % compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

infographic.key_insight: HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC reduced oxidation weight gain by 95.71% versus bare SA516 boiler steel, outperforming the other tested coatings.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This coating could improve SA516 boiler steel oxidation resistance through a dense protective oxide layer, reduced porosity, and increased microhardness.
method: Applied Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN coatings using HVOF and plasma spraying.
Conducted 50 cyclic air-oxidation tests at 900°C.
Characterized phases and microstructure using XRD, SEM/EDS, and X-ray mapping.
infographic.evidence_signal: Laboratory testing linked the best-performing coating to 95.71% lower weight gain and protective Cr2O3, TiO2, NiTiO4, and NiO formation, while bare steel showed severe oxide spalling and cracking.
infographic.watch_item: Performance over 50 laboratory air-oxidation cycles does not establish long-term durability under boiler combustion gases, erosion, or service loading.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of HVOF and plasma sprayed Ni–Cr-based ceramic coatings on SA516 boiler steel

zh-Hans.title: SA516锅炉钢表面HVOF及等离子喷涂Ni–Cr基陶瓷涂层的微观组织与高温氧化行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOF）和等离子喷涂（PS）技术，在SA516锅炉钢表面制备Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN涂层，并研究其微观组织与高温氧化行为。在实验室模拟环境中，于900°C下进行50次循环空气氧化试验，并采用X射线衍射（XRD）、配备能量色散谱的扫描电子显微镜（SEM/EDS）及X射线元素面分布分析，分析试验后的微观组织和物相变化。未涂覆的SA516钢氧化层发生严重剥落和开裂，并形成不具保护性的物相（Fe 2 O 3）。在所有涂层中，HVOF喷涂的Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层使最大增重较裸露SA516钢降低95.71%，表现出优异的抗氧化性能。涂层性能的提升归因于形成了由Cr 2 O 3、TiO 2、NiTiO 4和NiO组成的致密保护性氧化层，同时孔隙率降低、显微硬度提高。

infographic.key_insight: 与裸露SA516锅炉钢相比，HVOF喷涂的Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层使氧化增重降低95.71%，性能优于其他受试涂层。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该涂层可通过形成致密的保护性氧化层、降低孔隙率和提高显微硬度，改善SA516锅炉钢的抗氧化性能。
method: 采用HVOF和等离子喷涂技术制备Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN涂层。
在900°C下进行50次循环空气氧化试验。
采用XRD、SEM/EDS和X射线元素面分布分析表征物相及微观组织。
infographic.evidence_signal: 实验室试验表明，性能最佳的涂层与增重降低95.71%以及保护性Cr2O3、TiO2、NiTiO4和NiO的形成相关，而裸钢则出现严重的氧化层剥落和开裂。
infographic.watch_item: 50次实验室空气氧化循环中的性能表现，尚不足以确定其在锅炉燃烧气氛、冲蚀或服役载荷条件下的长期耐久性。

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.key_insight: In laser–TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, higher laser power deepens penetration, higher travel speed narrows and shallows the weld, and higher current widens the weld while stabilizing the arc.
infographic.engineering_relevance: These parameter–response relationships can guide weld penetration, geometry, and arc-stability control when manufacturing Invar molds for aerospace composites.
method: Numerical simulation of molten-pool dynamics
High-speed photography of welding behavior
Comparison across laser power, travel speed, and welding current
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports trends over 5–6 kW laser power, 0.5–0.8 m/min welding speed, and 150–170 A current, but provides no quantitative validation metrics.
infographic.watch_item: Higher power and speed can destabilize the arc; reported trends should not be extrapolated beyond the studied parameter ranges without validation.
infographic.paper_title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel

zh-Hans.title: Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中的熔池动态行为与电弧特性
zh-Hans.abstract: Invar钢具有极低的热膨胀系数，因此被广泛用于航空航天复合材料成型模具的制造。现有研究大多侧重于工艺方面，缺乏对熔池流体动力学行为的深入分析。因此，采用数值模拟和高速摄影，分析了不同工艺参数对Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接过程中熔池形貌演变和电弧特性的影响，为Invar钢焊接工艺的优化提供重要的理论支持。结果表明，在5 ~ 6 kW的激光功率范围内，功率增大会产生更大的反冲压力，从而增大熔深和小孔尺寸，加剧熔池整体流动；在高功率下，电弧易受激光吸引而发生偏转。在0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min的焊接速度范围内，速度提高会降低热输入，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，同时提高熔池流速和冷却速率；此外，在高焊接速度下，电弧易发生变形。在150 ~ 170 A的焊接电流范围内，电流增大会增强电弧力，促进焊缝宽度增大并加剧熔池对流；此外，在大电流下，电弧更加稳定。

infographic.key_insight: 在Invar钢激光–TIG复合焊接中，提高激光功率会增大熔深，提高焊接速度会使焊缝变窄、熔深减小，而增大电流会使焊缝变宽，同时提高电弧稳定性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些参数–响应关系可为航空航天复合材料用Invar模具制造过程中的焊接熔深、焊缝几何形状和电弧稳定性控制提供指导。
method: 熔池动力学数值模拟
焊接行为高速摄影
不同激光功率、焊接速度和焊接电流下的对比分析
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了激光功率为5–6 kW、焊接速度为0.5–0.8 m/min、电流为150–170 A范围内的变化趋势，但未提供定量验证指标。
infographic.watch_item: 较高的激光功率和焊接速度可能导致电弧失稳；未经验证，不应将所报告的趋势外推至所研究的参数范围之外。

title: Effect of Laser Remelting on the Microstructure, Mechanical and Tribological Properties of Detonation-Sprayed NiCrFeBSiC Coatings for Mechanical Engineering Applications
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Laila Sulyubayeva, A.Y. Zhakupova, Daryn Baizhan, Nurbol Berdimuratov
abstract: This study investigates the effect of laser remelting on the microstructure, phase composition, mechanical properties, tribological behavior, and corrosion resistance of self-fluxing NiCrFeBSiC coatings deposited onto AISI 321 stainless steel by detonation spraying. The coatings were characterized before and after laser treatment using scanning electron microscopy (SEM), energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS), X-ray diffraction (XRD), instrumented indentation, adhesion testing, ball-on-disk tribometry, and potentiodynamic polarization measurements. SEM analysis revealed that laser remelting reduced coating porosity from 0.306 ± 0.014% to 0.15 ± 0.09%, accompanied by microstructural densification and a reduction in coating thickness. XRD analysis confirmed the preservation of the principal crystalline phases, including Ni3Fe, Cr7C3, CrB, and Ni3B, following laser treatment. The Vickers hardness increased from 1049.1 ± 43.4 to 1206.1 ± 63.1 HV, while the elastic modulus increased from 233.6 ± 6.2 to 258.4 ± 5.3 GPa. Furthermore, adhesion strength increased by 19.4%, whereas surface roughness decreased by 19.2%. Laser remelting significantly improved tribological performance, reducing the average coefficient of friction from 0.535 ± 0.048 to 0.409 ± 0.086 and the specific wear rate from 2.864 × 10−4 to 1.447 × 10−4 mm3/(N·m), corresponding to a 49.5% reduction in wear. Electrochemical measurements indicated a modest decrease in corrosion current density of approximately 3.0%, accompanied by changes in the morphology of corrosion-affected regions. The improvements are associated with laser-induced microstructural densification, redistribution of alloying elements, and preservation of hard reinforcing phases. These findings demonstrate the potential of combining detonation spraying with laser remelting to produce wear-resistant nickel-based protective coatings for mechanical and power engineering applications.
venue: Journal of Manufacturing and Materials Processing

infographic.engineering_relevance: This combined coating process offers a promising route to wear-resistant protection for stainless-steel components in mechanical and power engineering.

zh-Hans.title: 激光重熔对机械工程用爆炸喷涂NiCrFeBSiC涂层微观组织、力学性能和摩擦学性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了激光重熔对采用爆炸喷涂在AISI 321不锈钢基体上沉积的自熔性NiCrFeBSiC涂层的微观组织、相组成、力学性能、摩擦学行为和耐腐蚀性的影响。采用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、能量色散X射线光谱（EDS）、X射线衍射（XRD）、仪器化压入测试、结合强度测试、球盘式摩擦磨损测试和动电位极化测量，对激光处理前后的涂层进行表征。SEM分析表明，激光重熔使涂层孔隙率从0.306 ± 0.014%降至0.15 ± 0.09%，同时使微观组织致密化并减小涂层厚度。XRD分析证实，激光处理后，Ni3Fe、Cr7C3、CrB和Ni3B等主要晶相得以保留。维氏硬度从1049.1 ± 43.4 HV提高至1206.1 ± 63.1 HV，弹性模量从233.6 ± 6.2 GPa提高至258.4 ± 5.3 GPa。此外，结合强度提高了19.4%，表面粗糙度降低了19.2%。激光重熔显著改善了摩擦学性能，使平均摩擦系数从0.535 ± 0.048降至0.409 ± 0.086，比磨损率从2.864 × 10−4 mm3/(N·m)降至1.447 × 10−4 mm3/(N·m)，对应的磨损降幅为49.5%。电化学测量表明，腐蚀电流密度小幅降低，降幅约为3.0%，同时受腐蚀区域的形貌发生变化。这些性能改善与激光诱导的微观组织致密化、合金元素再分布以及硬质增强相的保留有关。这些研究结果表明，将爆炸喷涂与激光重熔相结合，在制备用于机械和动力工程的耐磨镍基防护涂层方面具有潜力。

infographic.key_insight: 激光重熔使爆炸喷涂NiCrFeBSiC涂层致密化，提高了硬度和结合强度，同时使比磨损率降低了49.5%。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这种复合涂层工艺为机械和动力工程中的不锈钢部件提供耐磨防护，是一种有前景的技术途径。
method: 采用爆炸喷涂在AISI 321不锈钢上沉积NiCrFeBSiC，随后进行激光重熔。
采用SEM、EDS和XRD比较微观组织和相组成。
评估压入性能、结合强度、摩擦、磨损和电化学腐蚀行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: 重熔后，孔隙率从0.306%降至0.15%，硬度从1049.1 HV提高至1206.1 HV，比磨损率从2.864 × 10⁻⁴ mm³/(N·m)降至1.447 × 10⁻⁴ mm³/(N·m)。
infographic.watch_item: 重熔减小了涂层厚度，而腐蚀电流密度约3%的降幅表明，耐腐蚀性的改善幅度有限。

title: Microstructure and wear properties of Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings sprayed by conventional and supersonic high-velocity atmospheric plasma spraying with axial powder feeding
authors: Tadeusz Kubaszek, Anita Słyś, Marek Góral, Marcin Drajewicz, Kamil Gancarczyk
abstract: This study investigated the microstructural evolution and phase transformation mechanisms in Cr₃C₂-NiCr cermet coatings (Metco 5241 powder) plasma-sprayed onto S235 steel substrates.Two technologies were used: conventional atmospheric plasma spraying (APS) with radial powder injection (single-electrode A60 torch) and supersonic plasma spraying with axial powder feeding (HV-APS, three-electrode Axial III torch).The HV-APS coatings exhibited nearly halved porosity (6.16% vs. 11.99% for APS) and significantly higher microhardness (1141 HV0.2 vs. 897 HV0.2).Phase analysis revealed the disappearance of primary Cr 3 C 2 and Cr 21.26 Ni 1.74 C 6 carbides in favour of supersaturated Cr-Ni solid solutions.In the erosion tests conducted at a 90° impact angle, the two coating variants exhibited nearly identical specific erosion rates (0.20 mg/g for APS and 0.19 mg/g for HV-APS) and comparable damage mechanisms, dominated by fatigue-driven lamellar spalling and brittle fracture.However, in tribological tests (ball-on-disc, 30 N load), HV-APS coatings showed nearly 27% lower wear volume (2.85 mm 3 ) and a reduced specific wear rate (1.90 × 10 -4 mm 3 /Nm) compared to APS (3.90 mm 3 and 2.60 × 10 -4 mm 3 /Nm, respectively), correlating with their higher density and hardness.The obtained results confirm that the use of axial powder feeding in supersonic HV-APS plasma spraying significantly improves the mechanical and tribological properties of Cr₃C₂-NiCr coatings, although this advantage is not evident in the erosion tests at high impact angles.
venue: Advances in Science and Technology – Research Journal

infographic.key_insight: Supersonic HV-APS with axial powder feeding produced denser, harder Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings with approximately 27% lower sliding wear volume than conventional radial-feed APS, but little improvement in normal-impact erosion.
infographic.engineering_relevance: HV-APS is a promising process choice for sliding-wear protection of steel components, although its benefits should not be assumed for erosion-dominated service.
method: Sprayed Metco 5241 Cr₃C₂–NiCr powder onto S235 steel using conventional radial-feed APS and axial-feed HV-APS.
Characterized coating microstructure, phases, porosity and microhardness.
Compared erosion at 90° impact and ball-on-disc sliding wear under a 30 N load.
infographic.evidence_signal: HV-APS versus APS yielded 6.16% versus 11.99% porosity, 1141 versus 897 HV0.2 hardness, 2.85 versus 3.90 mm³ sliding wear volume, and nearly identical erosion rates of 0.19 versus 0.20 mg/g.
infographic.watch_item: The comparison changes both torch technology and powder-feeding geometry, so the improvement cannot be attributed to axial feeding alone.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure and wear properties of Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings sprayed by conventional and supersonic high-velocity atmospheric plasma spraying with axial powder feeding

zh-Hans.title: 常规大气等离子喷涂与轴向送粉超音速高速大气等离子喷涂制备的Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的显微组织与磨损性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了在S235钢基体上等离子喷涂制备的Cr₃C₂-NiCr金属陶瓷涂层（Metco 5241粉末）的显微组织演变与相变机制。采用了两种技术：径向送粉常规大气等离子喷涂（APS，单电极A60喷枪）和轴向送粉超音速等离子喷涂（HV-APS，三电极Axial III喷枪）。HV-APS涂层的孔隙率接近降低一半（6.16%，而APS为11.99%），显微硬度则显著提高（1141 HV0.2，而APS为897 HV0.2）。物相分析表明，原始Cr₃C₂和Cr₂₁.₂₆Ni₁.₇₄C₆碳化物消失，取而代之的是过饱和Cr-Ni固溶体。在冲击角为90°的冲蚀试验中，两种涂层的比冲蚀率几乎相同（APS为0.20 mg/g，HV-APS为0.19 mg/g），损伤机制也相近，均以疲劳驱动的层片剥落和脆性断裂为主。然而，在摩擦学试验（球-盘试验，载荷30 N）中，HV-APS涂层的磨损体积（2.85 mm³）比APS涂层（3.90 mm³）低近27%，比磨损率也有所降低（HV-APS为1.90 × 10⁻⁴ mm³/Nm，APS为2.60 × 10⁻⁴ mm³/Nm），这与其更高的致密度和硬度相关。所得结果证实，在超音速HV-APS等离子喷涂中采用轴向送粉可显著改善Cr₃C₂-NiCr涂层的力学性能和摩擦学性能，但这一优势在高冲击角冲蚀试验中并不明显。

infographic.key_insight: 与常规径向送粉APS相比，轴向送粉超音速HV-APS制备的Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层更致密、硬度更高，滑动磨损体积降低约27%，但在垂直冲击条件下的抗冲蚀性能改善甚微。
infographic.engineering_relevance: HV-APS是一种有前景的钢制部件抗滑动磨损防护工艺，但不应假定其优势同样适用于以冲蚀为主的服役工况。
method: 采用常规径向送粉APS和轴向送粉HV-APS，将Metco 5241 Cr₃C₂–NiCr粉末喷涂到S235钢上。
表征涂层的显微组织、物相、孔隙率和显微硬度。
比较90°冲击角下的冲蚀性能以及30 N载荷下的球-盘滑动磨损性能。
infographic.evidence_signal: HV-APS与APS涂层的孔隙率分别为6.16%和11.99%，硬度分别为1141和897 HV0.2，滑动磨损体积分别为2.85和3.90 mm³，冲蚀率几乎相同，分别为0.19和0.20 mg/g。
infographic.watch_item: 该对比同时改变了喷枪技术和送粉几何方式，因此不能将性能改善仅归因于轴向送粉。

title: Effect of Laser Post-Treatment on the Microstructure, Mechanical and Tribological Properties of Detonation- and Flame-Sprayed Ni–Cr–Fe–Si–B–C Coatings
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Aiym Nabioldina, Dosym Yerbolatuly, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: This study investigates the effect of laser post-treatment on the microstructure, phase composition, mechanical, and tribological properties of self-fluxing Ni–Cr–Fe–Si–B–C coatings deposited by detonation spraying (DS) and gas-flame spraying (GFS) onto AISI 321 stainless steel substrates. The coatings before and after laser treatment (LT) were examined using scanning electron microscopy, energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy, X-ray diffraction, instrumented indentation, and ball-on-disk tribological testing. The as-deposited coatings were characterized by a dense structure and low porosity, amounting to 0.306 ± 0.014% for the DS coatings and 0.433 ± 0.011% for the GFS coatings. Phase analysis revealed a multiphase structure consisting predominantly of a γ-(Ni,Fe) matrix reinforced by Cr7C3 carbide, CrB and Ni3B borides, as well as Ni31Si12 silicide. After laser treatment, the main crystalline phases were preserved; however, changes in the relative intensities of the diffraction peaks were observed, suggesting microstructural modifications during rapid melting and subsequent solidification. The mechanical response to laser treatment depended on the coating deposition method. For the DS coating, Vickers hardness increased from 1049.1 ± 43.4 to 1206.1 ± 63.1 HV, while the elastic modulus increased from 233.6 ± 6.2 to 258.4 ± 5.3 GPa. For the GFS coating, hardness increased from 1096.2 ± 58.8 to 1121.3 ± 49.1 HV, whereas the elastic modulus decreased from 228.0 ± 5.9 to 187.0 ± 8.8 GPa. Laser treatment also improved the wear resistance of both coating types. The wear rate of the DS coating decreased from 1.939 × 10−4 to 1.465 × 10−4 mm3/(N × m), while that of the GFS coating decreased from 2.419 × 10−4 to 1.476 × 10−4 mm3/(N × m), corresponding to reductions of approximately 24% and 39%, respectively. Under dry sliding conditions, the coefficient of friction of the DS coating remained nearly unchanged after laser treatment, decreasing slightly from 0.627 to 0.620, whereas that of the GFS coating decreased from 0.623 to 0.582. These findings demonstrate that laser post-treatment can improve the mechanical and tribological performance of self-fluxing Ni–Cr–Fe–Si–B–C coatings, with the magnitude and nature of these improvements depending on the initial microstructure formed by the respective spraying method.

infographic.key_insight: Laser post-treatment improved wear resistance in both Ni–Cr–Fe–Si–B–C coatings, while its effects on hardness and elastic modulus depended on the spraying method.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Laser post-treatment offers a route to more wear-resistant sprayed coatings on AISI 321 stainless steel, but stiffness requirements should guide process selection.
method: Deposit coatings by detonation spraying (DS) and gas-flame spraying (GFS), then apply laser post-treatment.
Characterize microstructure and phases using SEM, EDS, and X-ray diffraction.
Measure mechanical response by instrumented indentation and dry-sliding wear by ball-on-disk testing.
infographic.evidence_signal: Wear rates decreased by approximately 24% for DS and 39% for GFS; DS hardness increased from 1049.1 to 1206.1 HV, while GFS elastic modulus decreased from 228.0 to 187.0 GPa.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract reports dry-sliding performance only, so durability under lubricated, corrosive, or thermally cycled service remains unestablished.
infographic.paper_title: Effect of Laser Post-Treatment on the Microstructure, Mechanical and Tribological Properties of Detonation- and Flame-Sprayed Ni–Cr–Fe–Si–B–C Coatings

zh-Hans.title: 激光后处理对爆炸喷涂和火焰喷涂 Ni–Cr–Fe–Si–B–C 涂层微观组织、力学性能及摩擦学性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究探讨了激光后处理对采用爆炸喷涂（DS）和气体火焰喷涂（GFS）在 AISI 321 不锈钢基体上沉积的自熔性 Ni–Cr–Fe–Si–B–C 涂层的微观组织、相组成、力学性能及摩擦学性能的影响。采用扫描电子显微镜、能量色散 X 射线光谱、X 射线衍射、仪器化压入和球盘式摩擦学试验，对激光处理（LT）前后的涂层进行了表征。沉积态涂层具有致密结构和低孔隙率，其中 DS 涂层和 GFS 涂层的孔隙率分别为 0.306 ± 0.014% 和 0.433 ± 0.011%。物相分析表明，涂层具有多相结构，主要由 γ-(Ni,Fe) 基体以及起强化作用的 Cr7C3 碳化物、CrB 和 Ni3B 硼化物及 Ni31Si12 硅化物组成。激光处理后，主要晶相得以保留；但观察到衍射峰相对强度发生变化，表明快速熔化及随后凝固过程中可能发生了微观组织变化。涂层对激光处理的力学响应取决于涂层沉积方法。DS 涂层的维氏硬度从 1049.1 ± 43.4 HV 增至 1206.1 ± 63.1 HV，弹性模量从 233.6 ± 6.2 GPa 增至 258.4 ± 5.3 GPa。GFS 涂层的硬度从 1096.2 ± 58.8 HV 增至 1121.3 ± 49.1 HV，而弹性模量从 228.0 ± 5.9 GPa 降至 187.0 ± 8.8 GPa。激光处理还提高了两类涂层的耐磨性。DS 涂层的磨损率从 1.939 × 10−4 mm3/(N × m) 降至 1.465 × 10−4 mm3/(N × m)，GFS 涂层的磨损率从 2.419 × 10−4 mm3/(N × m) 降至 1.476 × 10−4 mm3/(N × m)，降幅分别约为 24% 和 39%。在干滑动条件下，DS 涂层的摩擦系数在激光处理后基本保持不变，仅从 0.627 略降至 0.620，而 GFS 涂层的摩擦系数则从 0.623 降至 0.582。这些结果表明，激光后处理可改善自熔性 Ni–Cr–Fe–Si–B–C 涂层的力学性能和摩擦学性能，而改善的幅度及具体表现取决于相应喷涂方法形成的初始微观组织。

infographic.key_insight: 激光后处理提高了两类 Ni–Cr–Fe–Si–B–C 涂层的耐磨性，而其对硬度和弹性模量的影响取决于喷涂方法。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 激光后处理为提高 AISI 321 不锈钢上喷涂涂层的耐磨性提供了一种途径，但工艺选择应以刚度要求为依据。
method: 采用爆炸喷涂（DS）和气体火焰喷涂（GFS）沉积涂层，然后进行激光后处理。
采用 SEM、EDS 和 X 射线衍射表征微观组织与物相。
通过仪器化压入测量力学响应，并通过球盘式试验测量干滑动磨损。
infographic.evidence_signal: DS 和 GFS 涂层的磨损率分别降低约 24% 和 39%；DS 涂层的硬度从 1049.1 HV 增至 1206.1 HV，而 GFS 涂层的弹性模量从 228.0 GPa 降至 187.0 GPa。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要仅报告了干滑动性能，因此涂层在润滑、腐蚀或热循环服役条件下的耐久性仍未得到证实。

title: EFFECT OF CEO2 AND LA2O3 REINFORCEMENTS ON MECHANICAL, TRIBOLOGICAL AND MICROSTRUCTURAL PROPERTIES OF WC–12CO COATING BY HIGH-VELOCITY OXYGEN FUEL DEPOSITION TECHNIQUE
authors: Satyanarayan Dubey, Shyam Birla, Tribhuwan Kishore Mishra
abstract: Decarburization during HVOF deposition reduces the workability of Tungsten Carbide-12% Cobalt (WC-12Co) coatings. This work examines how CeO2 and La2O3 reinforcements affect HVOF-sprayed WC-12Co coatings' mechanical, tribological, and microstructural characteristics. Compared to the unreinforced coating, microstructure, phase composition, bond strength, abrasive wear, coefficient of friction, and microhardness were assessed. CeO2 or La2O3 decreased porosity and finer grain structure without affecting bond strength. Coatings with 1 wt.% CeO2 and La2O3 increased microhardness by 6% and 4%, respectively, compared to the unreinforced WC-12Co coating, which had an adhesive bond strength of 73.60 ± 5 MPa. Both changed coatings improved structural stability, grain refinement, and densification. Minimum wear rate of 3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/N·m was found in WC-12Co-1La2O3, whereas the lowest coefficient of friction was 0.4 in WC-12Co-1CeO2. An oxide layer from reinforcements enhanced wear resistance. SEM investigation of worn surfaces showed debris, dislodged carbide particles, SiC grains, microcracks, and grooves as the predominant wear processes.

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

infographic.engineering_relevance: These findings can guide coating-process selection for machine parts exposed to intensive friction and high loads.

title: Interpretable ensemble learning for tensile strength prediction and welding process window optimization of friction stir-welded 7N01 aluminum alloy
authors: Xiaocui Wu, Yingjie Zhao, Huijie Zhang, Qi Cheng, Limao Wei, Yuwang Liu
abstract: This study aims to achieve high-accuracy prediction of the ultimate tensile strength (UTS) of friction stir-welded A7N01P-T4 aluminum alloy joints, elucidate the effects of welding parameters on UTS, and optimize the welding process window. Rotational speed, welding speed, and shoulder plunge depth were used as input variables, with UTS as the output. Machine learning models were developed using 27 experimental samples and evaluated by leave-one-out cross-validation. Comparison of decision tree, K-nearest neighbors, and Gaussian process regression identifies decision tree as the best baseline model, with an R 2 of 0.905. An ensemble learning strategy was subsequently introduced to construct a gradient boosting decision tree, increasing R 2 to 0.966, and grid search optimization of its key hyperparameters further improves R 2 to 0.978. SHapley Additive exPlanations analysis shows that the importance of the welding parameters follows the order of welding speed, rotational speed, and shoulder plunge depth, and the identified parameter effects agree well with the experimental results and observed microstructural evolution. The optimized model predicts fully feasible ranges of all the welding parameters for a joint efficiency of at least 90%, and the shoulder plunge depth acts as a key parameter for further refining the high-strength welding process window. These results demonstrate that the proposed approach not only improves the accuracy of UTS prediction but also reveals welding parameter effects and enables optimization of the welding process window, providing a quantitative basis for selecting FSW parameters.

zh-Hans.title: 用于搅拌摩擦焊7N01铝合金抗拉强度预测与焊接工艺窗口优化的可解释集成学习
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究旨在高精度预测搅拌摩擦焊A7N01P-T4铝合金接头的极限抗拉强度（UTS），阐明焊接参数对UTS的影响，并优化焊接工艺窗口。以转速、焊接速度和轴肩压入深度为输入变量，以UTS为输出，利用27个实验样本建立机器学习模型，并采用留一交叉验证进行评估。通过比较决策树、K近邻和高斯过程回归，确定决策树为最佳基线模型，其R²为0.905。随后引入集成学习策略，构建梯度提升决策树，将R²提高至0.966，并通过网格搜索优化其关键超参数，进一步将R²提高至0.978。沙普利加性解释（SHapley Additive exPlanations）分析表明，焊接参数的重要性依次为焊接速度、转速和轴肩压入深度，所揭示的参数影响与实验结果及观察到的显微组织演变吻合良好。优化后的模型预测了接头效率至少达到90%时所有焊接参数的完全可行范围，而轴肩压入深度是进一步细化高强度焊接工艺窗口的关键参数。这些结果表明，所提出的方法不仅提高了UTS预测精度，还揭示了焊接参数的影响，并实现了焊接工艺窗口优化，为搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）参数选择提供了定量依据。

title: Phase Evolution and Structure–Property Relationships of Fe79Zr6Si14Cu1 Coatings with Low GFA Produced by Atmospheric Plasma Spraying
authors: Inez Kredowska, Wirginia Pilarczyk, Aleksandra Małachowska, Paweł Sokołowski, Katarzyna Młynarek-Żak, Paweł M. Nuckowski
abstract: coatings were deposited by APS in order to investigate the influence of spray distance on microstructural development and structure-property relationships. Despite the rapid solidification conditions associated with APS, all coatings exhibited predominantly crystalline multiphase microstructures composed of α-Fe(Si) and Fe-Zr intermetallic phases, with no detectable amorphous fraction in the XRD patterns. The coatings developed a characteristic lamellar morphology with porosity ranging from 2.2 to 4.9%, strongly dependent on spray distance and particle thermal history. Increasing spray distance promoted higher hardness and improved wear resistance but simultaneously deteriorated corrosion resistance due to increased porosity and interlamellar defect population. Among the investigated conditions, the coating deposited at 90 mm exhibited the most favourable balance of hardness, wear resistance, and electrochemical behaviour owing to its relatively dense and cohesive microstructure. The results demonstrate that phase evolution in low-GFA Fe-Zr-Si-Cu alloys processed by APS is governed not only by rapid cooling rates but also by splat-based solidification, repeated thermal cycling, and heterogeneous nucleation during coating build-up.

title: Investigation of the Effect of HVOF Spray Parameters on the Quality Properties of Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr) Coating on Ti6Al4V Substrate
authors: Hariharan Venkataraman, Vishal Uttamrao Bagade, V.M. Biju
abstract: Systematic optimization of high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) spray parameters, such as spray distance, powder feed rate, and fuel gas flow rates, requires numerous experiments to determine the conditions that maximize coating quality. In this study, full factorial design (FFD), a more robust and efficient methodology than the traditional one-factor-at-a-time (OFAT) methodology, was employed to investigate the influence of HVOF spray parameters of Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coating deposited onto a Ti6Al4V substrate. The design of experiments (DOE) approach using an FFD with 24 experimental runs was employed to evaluate all input factors at two levels. The coating response properties were measured for each experimental run. Analysis of variance (ANOVA) was used to quantify the contribution of each spray parameter to the output responses. The effect of the interaction between spray parameters, such as spray distance, powder feed rate, and fuel gas flow rates, on the coating properties for this substrate-coating combination has scarcely been reported. Hence, a Pareto chart was also utilized to analyze the interaction effects of the spray parameters on coating properties. Finally, acceptable quality attributes such as hardness, porosity, and oxides were established with the spraying parameters, namely, standoff distance, powder feed rate, hydrogen flow rate, and oxygen flow rate, respectively, at the values of 150 mm, 25 g/min, 475 NLPM, and 205 NLPM.

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Dense, low-porosity Fe-based amorphous coatings improve long-term corrosion resistance, while increasing humidity reduces friction and wear.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Detonation-spray parameter control can help produce protective coatings for Q235 steel, with wear performance dependent on service humidity.
method: Deposit Fe-based amorphous coatings on Q235 steel using varied detonation-spray parameters.
Examine droplet morphology and coating microstructure.
Evaluate long-term corrosion and tribological behavior under different humidity conditions.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract links higher porosity to poorer long-term corrosion resistance and reports decreasing friction coefficient and wear rate with increasing humidity.
infographic.watch_item: Humidity-dependent wear findings involve Si3N4 counterface balls and may not generalize to other contact materials.

zh-Hans.title: 铁基非晶涂层在不同湿度环境下的长期腐蚀行为与磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用不同喷涂参数，通过爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上成功制备了铁基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀行为和摩擦学行为。液滴呈圆盘状，具有最高的圆度和铺展系数，这对于减少涂层缺陷以及形成显微组织致密的精细层片结构涂层至关重要。涂层中孔隙缺陷的增多与长期耐腐蚀性的降低相关。此外，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对涂层在不同湿度条件下的磨损行为具有重要影响。涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率随湿度升高而降低。

infographic.key_insight: 致密、低孔隙率的铁基非晶涂层可提高长期耐腐蚀性，而湿度升高可降低摩擦和磨损。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 控制爆炸喷涂参数有助于在Q235钢上制备防护涂层，其磨损性能取决于服役环境湿度。
method: 采用不同的爆炸喷涂参数，在Q235钢上沉积铁基非晶涂层。
观察液滴形貌和涂层显微组织。
评估不同湿度条件下的长期腐蚀行为和摩擦学行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要指出，较高孔隙率与较差的长期耐腐蚀性相关，并报告摩擦系数和磨损率随湿度升高而降低。
infographic.watch_item: 湿度相关的磨损研究结果涉及Si3N4对磨球，可能不适用于其他接触材料。

title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Manarbek Kylyshkanov, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: The present study investigates the effect of flame-spraying process parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings. Corrosion-resistant AISI 321 austenitic chromium–nickel steel was used as the substrate material. The coatings were deposited by flame spraying using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system. To vary the thermal conditions of the spraying process, the oxygen-to-acetylene (O₂/C₂H₂) ratio was adjusted to 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. The spraying parameters were monitored using an Accuraspray 4.0 diagnostic system. The resulting coatings were characterized in terms of microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength. Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio resulted in densification of the coating structure and a decrease in porosity from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%. Concurrently, the surface roughness decreased from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, while the adhesion strength increased from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa. The highest average microhardness of 1051.7 HV was obtained at an O₂/C₂H₂ ratio of 1.1. Among the investigated spraying conditions, the coating produced at O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 exhibited the lowest porosity and surface roughness together with the highest adhesion strength. The results demonstrate that controlling the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio provides an effective means of tailoring the microstructural and mechanical characteristics of flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio improved coating density, smoothness, and adhesion, while peak microhardness occurred at an intermediate ratio of 1.1.
infographic.engineering_relevance: O₂/C₂H₂ ratio control offers a practical way to tailor flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si coatings for different surface-performance priorities.

zh-Hans.title: 火焰喷涂温度对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究探讨了火焰喷涂工艺参数对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层微观组织和力学性能的影响。采用耐腐蚀的AISI 321奥氏体铬镍钢作为基体材料，使用Metal Coat 6PM-II系统通过火焰喷涂制备涂层。为改变喷涂过程的热条件，将氧气与乙炔的比值（O₂/C₂H₂）分别调节为1.0、1.1和1.2。使用Accuraspray 4.0诊断系统监测喷涂参数。对所得涂层的微观组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度进行了表征。提高O₂/C₂H₂比值使涂层组织更加致密，孔隙率由1.97 ± 0.13%降至0.90 ± 0.09%。同时，表面粗糙度由4.70 ± 0.09 μm降至2.99 ± 0.11 μm，而结合强度由22.14 ± 4.3 MPa升至35.02 ± 3.9 MPa。当O₂/C₂H₂比值为1.1时，获得了最高的平均显微硬度，为1051.7 HV。在所研究的喷涂条件中，O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2时制备的涂层具有最低的孔隙率和表面粗糙度，以及最高的结合强度。结果表明，控制O₂/C₂H₂比值是调控火焰喷涂Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层微观组织和力学特性的有效手段。

infographic.key_insight: 提高O₂/C₂H₂比值可改善涂层的致密性、平滑度和结合性能，而显微硬度在中间比值1.1时达到峰值。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 控制O₂/C₂H₂比值为调控火焰喷涂Ni–Cr–B–Si涂层提供了一种实用方法，可满足不同的表面性能侧重需求。
method: 使用Metal Coat 6PM-II系统，在AISI 321钢上通过火焰喷涂制备Ni–Cr–B–Si涂层。
测试了1.0、1.1和1.2三种O₂/C₂H₂比值，并使用Accuraspray 4.0进行过程监测。
评估了微观组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未提供实测喷涂温度或使用寿命测试结果，因此不应将随比值变化而产生的性能改善视为已经验证的温度与耐久性之间的关系。

title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
authors: Vyacheslav Sirota, Sergey Savotchenko, Valeriya Strokova, Daniil Podgornyi, Marina Kovaleva
abstract: The surface properties of metal-ceramic coatings based on titanium dioxide are described in dependence on the detonation spraying conditions. It is found that such properties as surface roughness, surface thickness and its hydrophobicity can be controlled in the production process by selecting certain values of the technological parameters of the spraying process. The optimal values of the technological parameters of detonation spraying, ensuring maximum hydrophobicity of the produced coatings are determined. The roughness of the coating surface and the coating thickness depend on the speed of the nozzle passage in accordance with the inverse power law. The roughness and the contact angle depend on spray distance in accordance with a parabolic law. New equations are obtained that can be useful for predicting the characteristics of the coating surface, as well as for determining the optimal mode of spraying the coating, ensuring its best hydrophobicity.
venue: Iranian Journal of Materials Science and Engineering

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-spraying parameters can tune the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium dioxide–based metal-ceramic coatings.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The reported relationships can guide nozzle-speed and spray-distance selection to control coating geometry and maximize hydrophobicity.
method: Vary detonation-spraying process conditions.
Evaluate coating roughness, thickness, and contact angle.
Derive predictive equations and identify conditions for maximum hydrophobicity.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships between nozzle travel speed and roughness/thickness, and parabolic relationships between spray distance and roughness/contact angle, but gives no numerical results or validation metrics.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not specify parameter ranges or optimal settings, limiting direct transfer to production.

zh-Hans.title: 不同工艺条件下爆炸喷涂制备的钛基涂层的表面特性
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文描述了二氧化钛基金属陶瓷涂层的表面性能随爆炸喷涂条件的变化关系。研究发现，通过选择喷涂工艺参数的特定值，可以在生产过程中控制表面粗糙度、涂层厚度及其疏水性等性能。确定了使所制备涂层具有最大疏水性的爆炸喷涂工艺参数最优值。涂层表面粗糙度和涂层厚度与喷嘴移动速度之间呈反幂律关系。粗糙度和接触角随喷涂距离的变化符合抛物线规律。获得了新的方程，可用于预测涂层表面特性，以及确定使涂层具有最佳疏水性的最优喷涂工艺条件。

infographic.key_insight: 通过调整爆炸喷涂参数，可以调控二氧化钛基金属陶瓷涂层的粗糙度、厚度和疏水性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 所报告的关系可指导喷嘴移动速度和喷涂距离的选择，以控制涂层几何特征并使疏水性最大化。
method: 改变爆炸喷涂工艺条件。
评估涂层粗糙度、厚度和接触角。
推导预测方程，并确定实现最大疏水性的条件。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了喷嘴移动速度与粗糙度及厚度之间的反幂律关系，以及喷涂距离与粗糙度及接触角之间的抛物线关系，但未提供数值结果或验证指标。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未明确说明参数范围或最优设置，限制了这些结果直接应用于生产。
